headline: Banxico considera que mantener la tasa en 6.25% por un tiempo prolongado: Minuta
summary: After a recent cut to 6.25%, Banxico's board considered that keeping the rate at this level for a prolonged period is appropriate, according to the minutes. The minutes were published this week.
why: Banxico is Mexico's central bank, and its policy rate sets borrowing costs and influences the peso. Guidance on rate paths matters for bond and currency investors.
